candidates.change_summary: Change assignment to acc.unlockTime to always set unlockTime to the provided _unlockTime regardless of comparison with block.timestamp (removes min with block.timestamp).
Set acc.unlockTime to block.timestamp unconditionally (ignore provided _unlockTime), making deposits always unlock immediately at current block time.

Set acc.balance before the require check (move acc.balance += msg.value above the require), changing revert behavior when overflow would occur (though require here is tautological, this changes execution order relevantly).
Remove the require check (delete the require statement), allowing any add regardless of the previous overflow check (changes reversion conditions).
Change the LogFile.AddMessage call to record a different string ("Deposit" instead of "Put"), changing observable log history.
